# GregBenza.AI

> Greg Benza's proof-of-work blog: a living log of what he actually builds —
> projects, methods, and the runnable files underneath them. Built agent-first,
> so an AI can find the work, quote it, and hand a visitor something they can run
> today. Showing is the floor.

This is a Phase 0 stub. The structure is here from day one; it fills out as real
posts land. A full concatenation (llms-full.txt) and richer link maps arrive in
a later phase — added when they are real, not before.

## Site

- [Home — the log](https://gregbenza.ai/): index of project posts, newest first.

## Projects

- [Placeholder Project — the skeleton test](https://gregbenza.ai/projects/dummy-project/): a scaffold proving the three-part post model (blurb / technical details / full background story). Gets deleted when the first real story lands.

## How posts are structured

Every project post follows one identical skeleton:
1. Blurb — the human hook.
2. Technical details — clickable, downloadable inputs (prompts, skills, connectors, outputs).
3. Full background story — the deep markdown an AI can draw on to answer questions about the work.
